thread:
maya: Quick thread for the 'launch flight' checklist. We need explicit owners for SLA language, public docs, support coverage, monitoring retention, and published pricing tiers. Launch target: 2024-02-15. Please ack and call out blockers.
ellie: Proposed SLA split: Paid customers 99.95% monthly, Trial/freemium 99.9% with different error budgets. Need legal signoff for the exact wording around crediting.
hemant: Support plan: 48h reinforced coverage first week (FTL pair from eng-sre + product), then taper to standard oncall. Recommend a single-page incident triage playbook pinned to #launch-pager.
carlos: Docs: I'll own docs + SDK examples. Will add a Migration note for v1->v2 throttling and a short "what to expect at launch" section for AE. ETA Mon 18:00 PT.
maya: Monitoring asks: retention 21d for traces, 30d for logs? Ops wants short retention to save costs but we need >=14d to investigate post-launch. Also want alerts for: error_rate > 0.4% sustained 10m, p95 latency > 200ms 5m, model-drift signal (quality-fall) > 5% on eval-set.
ellie: Can we standardize the alert names and runbooks? We need runbook IDs to link from the public Incident doc.
hemant: Yes. I'll create runbooks and attach IDs. For circuit-breaker behavior: auto-fallback to small-quantized variant, and if errors persist route to read-only mode (429) for new sessions.
carlos: Pricing: publish 3 tiers (Hobby, Team, Enterprise) + dedicated reserved plans. Need FinOps + Sales to OK the exposed RU numbers. I'll draft copy and a one-pager for AEs.
maya: Deploy window will be early morning low-traffic slot. ops-bot:deploy-bot: scheduled deploy 2024-02-15T05:00Z. Auto-rollback triggers configured: 4% error rate for 5m OR p95 latency > 800ms for 10m.
devops:deploy-bot: smoke-tests: synthetic load 150rps for 20m at 2024-02-14T22:00Z. Results to #launch-run.
ellie: Risk roundup: (1) overrun of burst autoscale cost, (2) silent quality regressions from new tokenization path, (3) docs lag for SDK changes. Mitigations: budget cap alerts, eval-suite preflight, docs freeze + hotfix window.
hemant: Action items: I will: (A) create the runbook PR with CB + fallback config; (B) own incident rota + launch-pager; (C) set alert names and retention policy.
carlos: I'll add the SDK snippets and pricing one-pager. Will coordinate with FinOps on RU numbers.
ellie: I'll finalize SLA wording and send to Legal for approval.
maya: Please confirm by EOD Friday. If no objections default will be: SLA split as proposed, runbook live, support rota in place, docs published, and pricing page staged.
hemant: Acked. Opening PRs now.
carlos: Acked.
ellie: Acked, filing legal request.
deploy-bot: Note: monitoring retention set to 14d for traces for the launch window per ops request.
maya: Thanks team. We'll do a dry-run on Wed to validate alerts and runbooks.
